fa1481cb-03c3-54f8-955c-52d5236dccda.content: If ethical review is required, state the current status of that review.

35528264-cf67-5251-9d2d-d3a67086178d.content: Combine applicable descriptions of ethics, risk, data management, and accessibility into a 90–120 word statement.

8d5d9472-e6fa-50e8-820c-fbd28c624a00.content: For research requiring ethics review, approval is a prerequisite for beginning the relevant research activities.

26f95aa6-291a-5327-8f18-974ddea38524.content: If recruiting people, organizations, or cases, describe inclusion criteria solely in terms of characteristics necessary to address the research questions.

95d3e1c1-1b3b-5e55-a58d-2b6ca68702b9.content: Do not request sensitive personal information that is unnecessary for the research purpose.

dde28f6d-3e2b-5520-bb4b-665ae54c713c.content: If researching people, specify in the proposal what accessibility accommodations participants may request.

dec3fb63-a73c-5cc3-b28e-eed55afc5b9a.content: If researching people, specify in the proposal the procedure for requesting accessibility accommodations.

5f062279-7900-54e7-932e-63e2123b4665.content: Link each anticipated risk to its corresponding mitigation measure.

093799de-01e6-5708-806b-256102d56b55.content: Specify where collected materials will be stored.

0599ce25-231a-5861-bac3-6d9e3645c4f8.content: Specify which roles have access to the collected materials.

f204bb80-6d0a-5ce4-a3df-a698e2275e9e.content: Specify the retention period for collected materials.

b871d733-bcd0-5e3f-b3ff-5a3639a4cde7.content: Specify how materials will be disposed of after their retention period ends.

cf911c1e-6634-5965-acdd-72f82935812d.content: The ethics reviewer verifies whether each anticipated risk has a corresponding mitigation measure in place.
